title: Which columns the scan reads
prompt: What does this program print? `orders` has six columns, read from a CSV file. Type each printed line on its own line.
program:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

web = orders.filter(F.col("channel") == "web").select("order_id", "customer_id")
plan = web._jdf.queryExecution().executedPlan().toString()
read = plan.split("ReadSchema: ")[1]

for name in orders.columns:
    print(name, name + ":" in read)
print("EqualTo(channel,web)" in plan)
hints: Column pruning keeps only the columns the query uses. Does the filter use a column the result doesn't keep?
A simple comparison on a column is pushed into the reader, and the plan lists it under `PushedFilters`.
